value.rationale: Quadratic expected intrinsic travel distance is a motivated second metric moment, not a routine restatement of the first moment: first moment does not fix variance or the sharp second-moment shape extrema. The complete quartic parameterization and sharp minimum/supremum characterize a natural three-route network design problem. A strict short-distance CDF reversal near a two-loop degeneration shows the extremum is not a global first-order stochastic consequence. No theorem for arbitrary graphs is claimed.
